schedule.name: CDC adult schedule
schedule.description: Age-based adult schedule. Conditions that add vaccines (pregnancy, immunocompromise, asplenia, liver disease, HIV and others) are separate risk schedules, not part of this one.

rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 19 or older, 1 dose of any age-appropriate influenza vaccine every year.
CDC adult schedule 2025: age 65 or older, 1 dose every year; high-dose, recombinant or adjuvanted vaccine is preferred.

rules.review_reason: COVID-19 dosing depends on earlier doses and the product given. Check the CDC COVID-19 notes and current guidance.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 19 or older, 1 or more doses of the current vaccine (2 or more at age 65 or older).

rules.review_reason: Age 50 to 74: 1 dose only if at increased risk of severe RSV disease (the patient may self-attest).
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 50 through 74 with a risk factor, 1 dose.
CDC adult schedule 2025: age 75 or older, 1 dose if never vaccinated. No additional doses.
CDC adult schedule 2025: 1 dose Tdap, then Td or Tdap every 10 years. Unvaccinated or incomplete primary series: complete a 3-dose series (see notes).

rules.review_reason: MMR: 1 dose if no evidence of immunity. Evidence is birth before 1957, written proof of MMR, or lab evidence. Record 'evidence of immunity' to clear this.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 19 or older, 1 or 2 doses depending on indication if born in 1957 or later.

rules.review_reason: Varicella: 2 doses if no evidence of immunity. Evidence is US birth before 1980, 2 documented doses, provider-diagnosed varicella or zoster, or lab evidence. Record 'evidence of immunity' to clear this.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: 2 doses 4 to 8 weeks apart if no evidence of immunity.
CDC adult schedule 2025: age 50 or older, 2 doses of recombinant zoster vaccine 2 to 6 months apart (minimum 4 weeks).

rules.review_reason: HPV: 3 doses if started at age 15 or older, fewer if started at 9 to 14. Check earlier doses before giving.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: through age 26, 2 or 3 doses depending on age at the first dose.

rules.review_reason: Age 27 to 45: HPV vaccine is by shared clinical decision-making.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 27 through 45, shared clinical decision-making.

rules.review_reason: Pneumococcal: choose PCV15 (then PPSV23 at least 1 year later), PCV20 or PCV21. Check earlier PCV13 and PPSV23 doses first.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 50 or older, 1 dose of PCV15, PCV20 or PCV21 if no earlier conjugate vaccine.

rules.review_reason: Hepatitis B: 2, 3 or 4 doses depending on the vaccine used (2 doses for Heplisav-B). Check the series.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 19 through 59, complete the series.

rules.review_reason: Hepatitis B at age 60 or older: recommended with known risk factors; others may be vaccinated on request.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 60 or older with risk factors, or on request.

rules.review_reason: MenB at age 19 to 23: shared clinical decision-making when not at increased risk (16 to 18 is preferred).
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025: age 16 through 23, shared clinical decision-making.
